facts.summary: Primary fibrosis endpoint showed only a trend, not significance, at week 36 · Phase 2b · efruxifermin in compensated cirrhosis due to NASH · not yet approved

evidence.summary: A trend was observed for the primary endpoint of fibrosis improvement at 36 weeks, with 22% and 24% of the 28mg and 50mg EFX-treated groups, respectively
evidence.primary_endpoint_met: A trend was observed for the primary endpoint of fibrosis improvement at 36 weeks
evidence.safety: EFX was reported to be generally well-tolerated. Across all three groups, there was one death in a placebo patient who had pneumonia.
